Exercise: 60-75 minutes per session | Superset format with stretches between sets
Thoracic extension over foam roll - 45 sec
Standing chest opener (hands clasped behind back) - 30 sec
Standing hamstring stretch - 30 sec each leg
Doorway pec stretch - 30 sec each side
Lat stretch (overhead side bend) - 30 sec each side
Hip flexor stretch - 30 sec each side
Upper trap stretch - 30 sec each side
Thread the needle - 30 sec each side
Upper trap stretch - 30 sec each side
Calf Raises Single Leg (3 sec eccentric)
Pec minor stretch (corner or doorway) - 30 sec
Pre-Workout: Foam roll upper back for 2-3 minutes before each session
Form First: Focus on perfect form over weight for the first month
Progression: Add 5-10% weight when you can complete all reps with excellent form
Kyphosis Focus: Keep neck neutral, emphasize thoracic extension, stretch tight pecs/lats
Injury Prevention: Stop if you feel pain (not muscle fatigue), protect rotator cuff
Complementary Work: Pilates (Tuesday) and Yoga (Thursday) enhance this routine
